title: Anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='5'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#FFF0B3' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <rect x='28' y='35' width='44' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFCF9E'/>

  <path d='M28 42 C28 62, 18 72, 14 78' stroke='#5CB8E6' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

</svg>
